name: How long does a senior-friendly kitchen remodel take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a senior-friendly kitchen remodel take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a senior-friendly kitchen remodel depends on its complexity and scope. Minor updates, such as replacing fixtures or adding pull-out shelves, might take 1-3 weeks. A more extensive renovation, involving new layouts, custom cabinetry, and appliance relocation, could take 6-12 weeks from demolition to completion. This timeline includes design, material ordering, and construction phases. We provide a detailed project schedule upfront, allowing for planning and minimizing disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor senior-friendly kitchen remodels can take 1-3 weeks, while extensive renovations may take 6-12 weeks, depending on scope and materials.
